title: Fwrd webhook body
description: The JSON body Fwrd (https://www.fwrdsms.com) POSTs to a custom webhook for each forwarded text. Checked against the source of the shipped Fwrd 1.2.1 and of 1.3.1 on 2026-10-25.

content.description: The text message exactly as it arrived, whitespace and line breaks kept. Nothing is added: no title, timestamp or markup.

text.description: The same message again, identical to content. It's there so chat tools that read `text` (Mattermost, Rocket.Chat) work with no glue.

sender.description: Who sent the text, as Shortcuts hands it over (a phone number, a short code, a contact name or a letter sender ID). Present only when Include Who Sent It is on in Fwrd's Settings and the Sender field is set on Fwrd's action in Shortcuts.
